name: Architectural shingles
body: Class 4 impact-rated laminate shingles, nailed six to a shingle, not four.

name: Ridge vent
body: Lets the attic breathe along the peak, so summer heat leaves instead of baking the deck.

name: Synthetic underlayment
body: A tear-proof sheet over the whole deck, laid to snapped chalk lines.

name: Ice and water shield
body: Self-sealing membrane in every valley and around every pipe, where leaks start.

name: Roof deck
body: We walk every sheet after tear-off and replace soft decking before anything goes over it.
